name: Missouri
status_why: The live results site shows scripts a Cloudflare CAPTCHA, which is never worked around.
system: Secretary of State election night reporting at enr.sos.mo.gov (vendor not confirmed), plus official PDFs (Grand Totals, Results by County) on sos.mo.gov after the canvass; 116 local election authorities post their own.

results_page.label: Missouri Secretary of State: election results
results_page.source: answered one request with the kit's User-Agent (N4, 2026-10-10)

election.how_to_find: Grand Totals PDF after the canvass.

feeds.address: https://enr.sos.mo.gov/ (linked from https://www.sos.mo.gov/elections/results as 'Primary Election - August 4, 2026 Unofficial Results')
feeds.note: 403 Cloudflare managed challenge (captcha) to the script on 2026-10-09.

feeds.address: Official PDFs: https://www.sos.mo.gov/CMSImages/ElectionResultsStatistics/<year>GeneralElection.pdf (Grand Totals) and ActualResults-<Month><D><YYYY>.pdf (Results by County)
feeds.updates: Not live: weeks after the canvass
feeds.note: The results page answered 200 on 2026-10-09 and lists these back to 2012.

feeds.address: Local election authorities: St. Louis County (stlouiscountymo.gov board of elections), Kansas City (kceb.org), Jackson County (jcebmo.org), St. Louis City, Greene (vote.greenecountymo.gov)
feeds.note: Addresses from ballot/state_local_mo.py; results pages not checked.

races_in_feed: ENR: statewide, Congress, Legislature, judges and retention; county and local races mostly on the authorities' own sites.
how_counted: Local election authorities report to the Secretary of State's live page; official totals follow the canvass.

certify.body: the Missouri Board of State Canvassers
certify.rule: Issues its statement not later than the second Tuesday in December (Mo. Rev. Stat. 115.511).
certify.local_rule: Election authorities send abstracts by the second Tuesday after the election (115.507).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

scout_blocked: enr.sos.mo.gov (Cloudflare captcha, 403, 2026-10-09). Precinct files are sold, not published (mo_place_votes.py).
scout_plan: Blocked for scripts on the night: the live site sits behind a Cloudflare captcha, which must not be worked around. Show Missouri with a link to the Secretary's live page, or have John save its pages or exports by hand if he wants numbers; official totals come later from the Grand Totals PDF, which scripts can read. Check the biggest local authorities' results pages in late October for anything a script may read.
